section.title: New metric probe
section.text:
OMEGA read-only probe 2026-09-09: do the 54.1.0 metrics render? tpoPOC: the price bin holding the most time in the current UTC session, over 5-bps bins — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the session's first 60 minutes. tpoVAH: the upper edge of the 70% value area around the current session's point of control — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the session's first 60 minutes. tpoVAL: the lower edge of the 70% value area around the current session's point of control — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the session's first 60 minutes. tpoIBH: the highest price of the current session's first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that opening range closes. tpoIBL: the lowest price of the current session's first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that opening range closes. tpoShape: where the point of control sits inside the current session's value area, p-shape at or above 0.67 of its span and b-shape at or below the mirror — a point-in-time read at its own fold (p-shape / b-shape / balanced). pTpoPOC: the price bin that held the most time in the previous completed UTC session. pTpoVAH: the upper edge of the previous completed UTC session's 70% value area. pTpoVAL: the lower edge of the previous completed UTC session's 70% value area. donchianHi: the highest high of the last 20 closed bars — the Donchian channel's upper edge. donchianLo: the lowest low of the last 20 closed bars — the Donchian channel's lower edge.

priorSessionRecheck.conclusion: Two observations an hour apart, both null on both coins, with a live control in the same response. That rules out a one-off blip in a single call. It does NOT establish why: not diagnosed, and no cause is asserted here. A UTC-session boundary has not been crossed between the two observations, so 'populates at the next session roll' remains untested rather than refuted.
